name: @remix-camera/sillytavern-setup
description: Local SillyTavern bridge and extension for Remix.Camera AI companion images.

scripts.check: node --check lib/companion-tools.mjs && node --check adapters/shared/bridge-client.mjs && node --check adapters/telegram/remix-telegram-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/telegram/lily-bot.mjs && node --check adapters/discord/remix-discord-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/discord/register-commands.mjs && node --check adapters/discord/lily-interactions-server.mjs && node --check adapters/whatsapp/remix-whatsapp-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/whatsapp/lily-webhook-server.mjs && node --check adapters/slack/remix-slack-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/slack/lily-slash-command-server.mjs && node --check adapters/line/remix-line-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/line/lily-webhook-server.mjs && node --check adapters/messenger/remix-messenger-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/messenger/lily-webhook-server.mjs && node --check adapters/matrix/remix-matrix-tool.mjs && node --check adapters/matrix/lily-sync-bot.mjs && node --check adapters/flowise/remix-camera-flowise-tool.js && node --check adapters/botpress/remix-camera-botpress-action.js && node --check adapters/risu/remix-camera-companion-images.risu.js && node --check adapters/agnai/remix-camera-agnai.user.js && python3 -m py_compile adapters/openwebui/remix_camera_companion_images.py && node --check bridge/server.mjs && node --check bridge/live-e2e.mjs && node --check bridge/server.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/companion-tools.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/telegram-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/discord-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/whatsapp-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/slack-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/line-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/messenger-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/matrix-tool.node-test.mjs && node --check tests/extension-settings.node-test.mjs && node --check index.js && node --check extension/remix-camera-companion-images/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.readFileSync('index.js','utf8') !== fs.readFileSync('extension/remix-camera-companion-images/index.js','utf8')) throw new Error('Root and nested extension entrypoints differ');" && node --check bin/setup.mjs && node --check scripts/embed-character-card-png.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-character-card.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-adapter-demos.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-telegram-live-demo.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-sillytavern-browser-e2e.mjs && node scripts/verify-character-card.mjs
scripts.test: node --test bridge/server.node-test.mjs tests/companion-tools.node-test.mjs tests/telegram-tool.node-test.mjs tests/discord-tool.node-test.mjs tests/whatsapp-tool.node-test.mjs tests/slack-tool.node-test.mjs tests/line-tool.node-test.mjs tests/messenger-tool.node-test.mjs tests/matrix-tool.node-test.mjs tests/extension-settings.node-test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npx --yes --package=playwright -- bash -lc 'PLAYWRIGHT_BIN="$(command -v playwright)"; PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_PATH="$(cd "$(dirname "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN")/../playwright" && pwd)/index.js"; export PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_PATH; node scripts/verify-sillytavern-browser-e2e.mjs "$@"' --
scripts.test:browser:live: npx --yes --package=playwright -- bash -lc 'PLAYWRIGHT_BIN="$(command -v playwright)"; PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_PATH="$(cd "$(dirname "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN")/../playwright" && pwd)/index.js"; export PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_PATH; node scripts/verify-sillytavern-browser-e2e.mjs --real-api "$@"' --
